independence_evidence: Published by We Jazz Oy, which describes itself as 'an independent music culture company based in Helsinki' running a record label, festival and the magazine (https://wejazz.fi/info/).
qualifies_reason: Independent Helsinki quarterly whose Issue 20 (Fall 2026) went on sale 18 September 2026.
what_it_is: We Jazz Magazine is a quarterly English-language journal about jazz and creative music, with each issue built around a focus artist (Issue 20 is devoted to Thelonious Monk) plus long-form profiles, a record-collecting column, album and live reviews and photo essays. It is a 128-page, 170 x 240 mm print edition sold with a bonus digital album. It is for listeners of jazz, improvised and experimental music.
